card.title: Lessons for Travelers
card.passage: Many people enjoy traveling to other countries. However, they sometimes worry about speaking foreign languages. Now, some companies offer short online lessons for travelers. Travelers take such lessons before their trips, and by doing so they can learn useful phrases for airports and hotels quickly.

steps.t: Hello. My name is Ms. Brown. May I have your name, please?
Thank you. This is the Grade Pre-2 test. OK? How are you today?
Let's start the test. Here is your card.
First, please read the passage silently for 20 seconds.
All right. Now, please read it aloud.
Now, I'll ask you five questions.
Number 1. According to the passage, how can travelers learn useful phrases for airports and hotels quickly?
Number 2. Now, please look at the people in Picture A. They are doing different things. Tell me as much as you can about what they are doing.
Number 3. Now, look at the woman in Picture B. Please describe the situation.
Now, please turn over the card and put it down.
Number 4. Do you think more people will take online lessons in the future?
Number 5. These days, many people enjoy camping. Do you like to go camping?
This is the end of the test. Could I have the card back, please?
Thank you. You may go now.

points: However, / Now, のあとで少し区切る
by doing so を自然につなげる

q1.q: According to the passage, how can travelers learn useful phrases for airports and hotels quickly?
q1.ja: 旅行者は、どうすれば空港やホテルで役立つ表現を早く学べますか。
model: By taking such lessons before their trips.
They take short online lessons before their trips.
points: by doing so の doing so が指す内容を答える
such lessons → short online lessons と言いかえてもOK

q2.q: Tell me as much as you can about what they are doing.
q2.ja: (イラストA)人々がしていることを、できるだけたくさん説明してください。
model: A man is reading a newspaper. A girl is drinking juice. A woman is carrying a box. A boy is riding a bicycle. A man is talking on the phone.
points: carry a box / ride a bicycle / talk on the phone

q3.ja: (イラストB)女性の状況を説明してください。
model: She wants to take a picture of the mountain, but she can't because it's cloudy.
points: 吹き出しの「したいこと」+ できない理由
wants to ～, but she can't because ～

q4.q: Do you think more people will take online lessons in the future?
q4.ja: 将来、オンラインレッスンを受ける人は増えると思いますか。

model.yes: Yes. → People can take lessons at home. They don't need to go to a school, so it saves time.
model.no: No. → Many people want to talk with teachers face to face. They can learn better in a classroom.

q5.q: Do you like to go camping?
q5.ja: キャンプに行くのは好きですか。

model.yes: Yes. → I like cooking outside with my family. Last summer, we went camping near a lake.
model.no: No. → I don't like insects. I prefer staying in a hotel.

points: Yes なら具体的な経験を
